engine.description: Which engine answered. Informational: a client must not branch on it.

world_schema.description: The version of the world schema the engine's records are in. Opaque; compare for equality only.

targets.description: In the order the engine offers them, which is the order of the panel list they come from.

word.description: The word the engine reads after a slash for this verb, as in `/word target`. Null for `use`, whose targets each carry a line of their own. Since revision 1.1.

lines.description: For `use` only (null for every other verb): the exact line to send to play each target, in the order of `targets`. An entry is null when the line would play another target named the same way. Since revision 1.1.

exits.description: Ordered as the engine recorded them (creation order), never by query order or name.

people.description: Ordered as the engine recorded them (creation order), never by query order or name.

lying_here.description: Ordered as the engine recorded them (creation order), never by query order or name.

carrying.description: Ordered as the engine recorded them (creation order), never by query order or name.

sheet.description: The stat block line, then the abilities line; either may be absent.

verbs.description: Always all eight verbs, in the enum's order: move, talk, examine, take, drop, attack, throw, use.

running_turn.description: While `busy`, the id of the turn in hand (the oldest, when more than one is waiting); open its events to follow it. Null when not busy. Since revision 1.1.
